tasks.title: Measure and bound end-to-end input->response latency
tasks.acceptance: scripts/latency_canary.py reports p50 < 30 ms and p99 < 50 ms over 200 actuate->observe trials, written to experiments/ as a JSON record.
tasks.notes: Every other number in the project is meaningless until this passes. See docs/SPEEDRUN_PLAN.md section 2.1.

tasks.title: Duplicate and dropped frame detection in the capture ring buffer
tasks.acceptance: A 10-minute capture reports zero duplicate and zero dropped frames via monotonic frame counters; the detector is unit-tested against a synthetic stream with injected gaps and repeats.

tasks.title: Replay record format with frame-indexed action log
tasks.acceptance: Round-trip write/read of a 1000-frame replay preserves frames, frame-indexed actions, events, HUD ground truth, outcome, loadout and game build with 0 differences; the loader raises on a 1-frame action misalignment injected by the test.

tasks.title: HUD template reader for HP, super cards and weapon
tasks.acceptance: 100% exact match on the 5000-frame held-out HUD fixture set, reported per boss; runtime under 1 ms per frame.

tasks.title: Pink parryable-object mask via HSV threshold
tasks.acceptance: Precision >= 0.95 and recall >= 0.90 against hand-labelled parryable objects on the fixture set; runtime under 1 ms per frame.

tasks.title: Symbolic event detector producing the discrete event trace
tasks.acceptance: F1 >= 0.95 against hand-labelled event traces across at least 3 bosses, reported per boss and per event class.

tasks.title: Evaluation harness with the statistical gate
tasks.acceptance: Given two arms of >= 30 attempts, reports median TTK, p10, death rate, DPS uptime, parry conversion, and a 10000-sample bootstrap CI on the difference in medians; unit-tested against synthetic distributions with known separation.

tasks.title: Latent dynamics with a hit-probability head
tasks.acceptance: Hit-prediction AUC >= 0.85 at k=8 steps on held-out replays, reported per boss, with the experiment record written to experiments/.

tasks.title: CEM planner over latent rollouts with the risk-constrained cost
tasks.acceptance: Median TTK beats the phase-2 baseline with bootstrap CI excluding zero at n >= 30, planning latency p99 <= 10 ms, and the stalling detector does not fire.
